desc:
📯 Taking place during the late 1800s you and your team must fight to survive the Zulu attack!

🛡️ Defend your base against up to 20 waves of Zulu alongside teammates to survive!
⚔️ Use an arsenal of weapons ranging from swords, breech-loading guns, lever-action guns, and even gatling guns to combat the Zulu assault!

📌 Please note that this game was not made with the intention of racism, nor does it support racism. If you encounter any ill-willed players use the Roblox report system.

Roblox Premium Benefits: 2x credits for kills

🛠️ Version v2.64
- New Gun/Tool System
- Changed Endless Waves to Extended Waves (Wave 20 Max)
- Extended Waves voting to decide whether or not to continue
- Capped max Zulus at 100
- Donate credits feature
- Icons for Bugle/Flag buffs
- Day/Night setting
- Zulu Patrol Bots

Playable on PC 🖥️, Mobile 📱 and Console 🎮
